_comment: Pinned program for 'Does #7 score the first goal?' on bernabeu-counter. Same detect->crop->read_text->filter->temporal_order->answer chain shape as the hero, but filters on a DIFFERENT non-hero jersey value (text == 7, the white scorer pinned to p_vini) so the verdict names #7, NOT #10 — proving the subject is DERIVED from the filter, not a hardcoded literal. Window 9000-11000ms @ fps8 (stride 125) covers the legible scorer frame (10000) and the goal moment (10500). Validates against ../schema/dsl.schema.json. end_ms 11000 <= clip duration_ms 30086.
